fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, this is dealer stock: the listing mentions a doc fee, the photos show a dealership lot with dealer plate frames (Kuehn Motor Company), and the text is a salesperson's ad.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and rear quarters already looks glossy and freshly cleaned
Tan leather seats and dash look clean and freshly detailed in the driver-side interior photo
Headlights and chrome trim look clear and bright
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2015 Jaguar XF. The British Racing Green paint and the tan leather already look sharp in the photos. If you ever need detailing or buffing for other cars on the lot, we come to you and would be glad to put together a quote.
